Part of the [pycyxwiz API reference](index.md), pycyxwiz 0.2.0: each name with the signature and description the module itself reports. Types are shown without the `pycyxwiz.` prefix; `Sequence[int]` is any list or tuple of integers.

## Functions

| Function | What it does |
|---|---|
| `is_sentencepiece_tokenizer_available() -> bool` | Return true when the optional SentencePiece tokenizer provider adapter is available |
| `sentencepiece_tokenizer_unavailable_message() -> str` | Return the canonical explanation for unavailable SentencePiece tokenizer support |

## Enumerations

- `BPEInitialUnit`: `Byte`, `UnicodeCharacter`
- `ByteBPEPiecePolicy`: `WhitespaceV1`, `LeadingSpaceV2`
- `TokenizerType`: `Whitespace`, `Word`, `Character`, `ByteBPE`, `WordPiece`, `SentencePieceBPE`, `SentencePieceUnigram`

## Classes

### `Tokenizer`

| Member | What it does |
|---|---|
| `Tokenizer(self: Tokenizer, type: TokenizerType = TokenizerType.Word) -> None` | Create a tokenizer |
| `decode(self: Tokenizer, token_ids: Sequence[int]) -> str` | Decode token IDs to text |
| `decode_batch(self: Tokenizer, batch: Sequence[Sequence[int]]) -> list[str]` | Decode batch of token IDs |
| `encode(self: Tokenizer, text: str) -> list[int]` | Encode text to token IDs |
| `encode_batch(self: Tokenizer, texts: Sequence[str]) -> list[list[int]]` | Encode batch of texts |
| `get_vocabulary(self: Tokenizer) -> Vocabulary` | Get the vocabulary |
| `pad_batch(self: Tokenizer, batch: Sequence[Sequence[int]], max_length: int = -1) -> list[list[int]]` | Pad a batch to uniform length |
| `set_add_bos(self: Tokenizer, value: bool) -> None` | Enable/disable BOS token |
| `set_add_eos(self: Tokenizer, value: bool) -> None` | Enable/disable EOS token |
| `set_bpe_fit_initial_unit(self: Tokenizer, unit: BPEInitialUnit) -> None` | Select BPE fit starting units; encoding follows the saved vocabulary |
| `set_bpe_fit_piece_policy(self: Tokenizer, policy: ByteBPEPiecePolicy) -> None` | Select ByteBPE fitting policy; encoding follows the saved vocabulary |
| `set_lowercase(self: Tokenizer, value: bool) -> None` | Enable/disable lowercase normalization |
| `set_max_length(self: Tokenizer, value: int) -> None` | Set maximum token sequence length |
| `set_padding(self: Tokenizer, value: bool) -> None` | Enable/disable padding |
| `set_truncation(self: Tokenizer, value: bool) -> None` | Enable/disable truncation |
| `set_vocabulary(self: Tokenizer, vocab: Vocabulary) -> None` | Set the vocabulary |
| `train(self: Tokenizer, documents: Sequence[str], min_freq: int = 1, max_vocab_size: int = -1) -> None` | Train tokenizer on documents (builds vocabulary) |
